problem: In a git worktree, `.git` points at `.git/worktrees/<name>`, which has no `hooks/` directory. Worktrees share the main repository's hooks, and `pre-commit install` writes them there (`git rev-parse --git-path hooks` gives `<main>/.git/hooks`). Following the gitdir path sends the reader to a directory that doesn't exist. A separate issue to file: `scripts/setup_dogfooding.sh` makes the same mistake in its hook check (`$GIT_DIR/hooks` taken from the `.git` file), so the setup reports 'Git hooks not properly installed' and exits 1 when run from a worktree, which contradicts 'The setup handles git worktrees automatically'.
replacement:
```bash
# Find the hooks directory (worktrees share the main repository's hooks)
git rev-parse --git-path hooks
```
